en.answer: If <<6654>> which was negated by <<10856>> is sent to the Graveyard, its effect is applied normally. If <<5323>> which was negated by <<10856>> Tributes itself to activate its effect, the effect is negated and the targeted monster is not destroyed.
en.question: If <<10856>> negates the effects of <<6654>>, will its effect be negated when it is sent to the Graveyard? Also, if <<10856>> negates the effects of <<5323>>, will its effect be negated if it Tributes itself to activate it?
en.title: If <<10856>> negates the effects of <<6654>>, will its effect be negated when it is sent to the Graveyard? Also, if <<10856>> negates the effects of <<5323>>, will its effect be negated if it Tributes itself to activate it?

ja.answer:
「<<10856>>」の効果が適用され効果が無効になっている「<<6654>>」が墓地へ送られた場合、その効果は通常通り発動し、効果処理も適用されます。

また、「<<10856>>」の効果が適用され効果が無効になっている「<<5323>>」は、自身をリリースして効果を発動する事はできますが、その効果は無効になり、選択したモンスターが破壊される事はありません。
